title: Hog Rider
blurb: Screamed with the total confidence of a man riding a hog directly into a mortar. Supercell's most committed unit does exactly one thing — run at the nearest building and refuse to reconsider — and the deployment yell has become shorthand for charging into any situation without a plan. Group projects, Black Friday queues, replying-all to a company-wide email at four in the afternoon. There is something genuinely admirable about the absence of strategy. An all-time gaming meme sound, and the only correct way to announce a bad decision.
origin: The Hog Rider deployment yell from Clash of Clans / Clash Royale (Supercell).
